description.value:
Frequency once per day

Duration 1 minute

Every contract you ever signed was the same contract: these people arrive.

Choose any number of allies you can see. For the duration they cannot die, cannot be reduced below 1 Hit Point, and cannot be removed from the battlefield by any effect. Every point of damage prevented this way is dealt to you instead, all at once, when the minute ends. You may be killed by it, and you have always known that was the arrangement.

cinderfall.incomplete: Chosen allies can't die, drop below 1 HP, or be removed from the field for 1 minute; all prevented damage hits the caster at the end. No selector prevents a different creature's HP from dropping or blocks their removal, and no companion effect exists to carry a mass, minute-long ally ward of this shape with real-time damage tracking across many allies simultaneously.
